opt.appliesNew: Applies to new fetches. Items already collected are not changed.

starter.title: Starter packs
starter.intro: Pick the ready-made sources to add in one go. Everything is keyless; you can rename or change any of them later.
starter.termsNote: Adding these sources records personal-use acceptance of each provider terms. Some providers are unofficial public endpoints and may change without notice.
starter.loadFailed: Could not load the available sources.

starter.linkedinStep2: In Gmail, add a filter for from:jobalerts-noreply@linkedin.com and label it LinkedIn Jobs.
starter.linkedinStep3: Add a Gmail source that reads the LinkedIn Jobs label.

guideSteps.generic.s1: Open the provider’s own documentation and note the endpoint and the scope it needs.
guideSteps.generic.s2: Fill in the scope fields shown below exactly as the provider spells them.
guideSteps.generic.s3: Accept the terms below (declared use) so the source is allowed to run.
guideSteps.generic.s4: Press Test connection to validate the saved draft, then activate the source.
guideSteps.genericKeyed.s1: Create a free account at the provider and generate an API key.
guideSteps.genericKeyed.s2: Paste the key into the API key field below; it is encrypted and never shown again.
guideSteps.genericKeyed.s3: Fill in the scope fields, then accept the terms below.
guideSteps.genericKeyed.s4: Press Test connection to validate the draft, then activate the source.
guideSteps.rss.s1: Find the site’s feed address: look for an RSS or Atom link, or try adding /feed or /rss to the site address.
guideSteps.rss.s2: Paste the full https feed URL into Source URL.
guideSteps.rss.s3: Choose a schedule; 15 to 60 minutes is enough for most news feeds.
guideSteps.rss.s4: Press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.rest.s1: Find a JSON API endpoint that returns a list of items and open it in a browser to see the shape.
guideSteps.rest.s2: Paste the https endpoint into API URL and set Items path to the list’s name (for example items).
guideSteps.rest.s3: Set the ID and content field names to match one item; if the API needs a header key, choose Header authentication and paste the key.
guideSteps.rest.s4: Press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.web.s1: Pick a public page whose text you want to track.
guideSteps.web.s2: Paste the https page address into Page URL.
guideSteps.web.s3: Keep the page limits low; only enable JavaScript rendering if the page is empty without it.
guideSteps.web.s4: Press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.mcp.s1: Get the address of an MCP server you trust and the list of tools it exposes.
guideSteps.mcp.s2: Add the server in MCP settings, review its tools, and enable only the read tools you need.
guideSteps.mcp.s3: Create the source against that server and choose a schedule.
guideSteps.mcp.s4: Press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.youtube.s1: Choose one channel ID, a list of channel IDs, handles, or playlist IDs.
guideSteps.youtube.s2: Paste it into the selected target field.
guideSteps.youtube.s3: Press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.arxiv.s1: Pick an arXiv category code such as cs.AI or q-fin.GN from arxiv.org/category_taxonomy.
guideSteps.arxiv.s2: Paste exactly one category into Category.
guideSteps.arxiv.s3: Press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.huggingface.s1: Open the author or organisation on huggingface.co and copy the name from the address.
guideSteps.huggingface.s2: Paste it into Author; new and updated models by that author are collected.
guideSteps.huggingface.s3: Press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.github_releases.s1: Open the repository on GitHub and note the owner and repository name from the address.
guideSteps.github_releases.s2: Fill in Owner and Repository; public releases need no sign-in.
guideSteps.github_releases.s3: Press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.github.s1: Connect your GitHub account first (the Connect button), then pick the repository to read.
guideSteps.github.s2: Fill in Owner and Repository and tick the kinds of activity to collect.
guideSteps.github.s3: Set how many days of history to fetch on the first run (up to 365).
guideSteps.github.s4: Press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.telegram.s1: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram and copy the bot token it gives you.
guideSteps.telegram.s2: Add the bot as an administrator of each channel you want to read.
guideSteps.telegram.s3: Paste the bot token into the credential field and list the channel IDs (negative numbers) in Channel IDs.
guideSteps.telegram.s4: Press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.alpha_vantage.s1: Get a free key at alphavantage.co/support/#api-key (a name and email are enough).
guideSteps.alpha_vantage.s2: Paste the key into the API key field.
guideSteps.alpha_vantage.s3: Enter up to the allowed number of ticker symbols, the currency and the exchange time zone.
guideSteps.alpha_vantage.s4: The free plan allows a small number of calls per day, so keep the schedule at once a day.
guideSteps.alpha_vantage.s5: Press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.open_meteo.s1: Look up the latitude and longitude of the place you want (any map site shows them).
guideSteps.open_meteo.s2: Enter them in Latitude and Longitude, plus your local time zone.
guideSteps.open_meteo.s3: List the hourly metrics you want, separated by commas (for example temperature or humidity).
guideSteps.open_meteo.s4: Open-Meteo is free for non-commercial use and needs no key. Press Test connection, then activate.
guideSteps.google_news.s1: Decide the search words you want to follow (up to 200 characters).
guideSteps.google_news.s2: Enter them in Search query; do not type site: here, use the site selector instead.
guideSteps.google_news.s3: Optionally restrict to one publisher and choose the language and region.
guideSteps.google_news.s4: Accept the terms below, press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.sec_edgar.s1: Find the company’s 10-digit CIK at sec.gov/edgar/searchedgar/companysearch (pad with leading zeros).
guideSteps.sec_edgar.s2: Enter it in CIK, and your own contact email in Contact email; SEC requires it to identify your requests.
guideSteps.sec_edgar.s3: Accept the terms below, press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.openalex.s1: Think of a topic or phrase that scholarly works should match.
guideSteps.openalex.s2: Enter it in Search query; no key is needed for OpenAlex basic use.
guideSteps.openalex.s3: Accept the terms below, press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.coingecko.s1: Create a free account at coingecko.com/en/api and add a Demo API key in the developer dashboard.
guideSteps.coingecko.s2: Save this source with the Demo API key, then search CoinGecko and select up to 20 coins. Existing sources continue with Bitcoin until changed.
guideSteps.coingecko.s3: Accept the terms below. Show the “Powered by CoinGecko” credit wherever you share the data.
guideSteps.coingecko.s4: Press Test connection, then activate the source. Each collection reads USD prices for the selected coins.
guideSteps.fred.s1: Create a free account at fredaccount.stlouisfed.org and request an API key under My Account.
guideSteps.fred.s2: Paste the 32-character key into the API key field.
guideSteps.fred.s3: Find the series ID on fred.stlouisfed.org (for example DFF for the fed funds rate, CPIAUCSL for CPI) and enter it in Series ID.
guideSteps.fred.s4: One source follows one series; create another source for another series. Accept the terms, test, then activate.
guideSteps.finnhub_news.s1: Create a free account at finnhub.io and copy the API key from the dashboard.
guideSteps.finnhub_news.s2: Paste it into the API key field. The free plan is for personal use.
guideSteps.finnhub_news.s3: Accept the terms below, press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.newsapi.s1: Register at newsapi.org/register and copy your API key.
guideSteps.newsapi.s2: Paste it into the API key field. The free Developer plan is for development use only and limits requests per day.
guideSteps.newsapi.s3: Accept the terms below (this source needs an instance operator review), test, then activate.
guideSteps.openweathermap.s1: Create a free account at openweathermap.org and copy the key from My API keys (new keys can take a couple of hours to start working).
guideSteps.openweathermap.s2: Paste it into the API key field.
guideSteps.openweathermap.s3: Enter the Latitude and Longitude of the place to follow.
guideSteps.openweathermap.s4: Accept the terms below, press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.openaq.s1: Create a free account at explore.openaq.org and copy your API key from the account page.
guideSteps.openaq.s2: Paste it into the API key field.
guideSteps.openaq.s3: Find a monitoring station on the OpenAQ map; the number at the end of its address is the Location ID. Enter it.
guideSteps.openaq.s4: Accept the terms below, press Test connection, then activate the source.
guideSteps.nasa_firms.s1: Request a free MAP_KEY at firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key (an email is enough).
guideSteps.nasa_firms.s2: Paste the key into the API key field.
guideSteps.nasa_firms.s3: Enter the three-letter ISO country code (for example VNM) in Country code.
guideSteps.nasa_firms.s4: Large countries can return more hotspots than fit one run; only the strongest are kept. Accept the terms, test, then activate.
scopeHint.news_query: Up to 200 characters. Spaces mean every word must appear; put OR between words to match any of them, "quotes" for an exact phrase and a leading - to exclude a word. Example: "interest rate" OR inflation -crypto. Do not type site: here; pick the publisher below.
scopeHint.scholarly_query: Up to 200 characters, searched in titles, abstracts and full text; newest works first. Use AND, OR, NOT in capitals and "quotes" for an exact phrase. Example: "large language model" AND safety.
scopeHint.sec_cik: Exactly 10 digits; pad with leading zeros (Apple = 0000320193). Look it up in EDGAR company search on sec.gov. One company per source.
scopeHint.sec_contact_email: A real address you read, for example name@company.com. The SEC blocks requests without a valid contact.
scopeHint.fred_series_id: One series ID from fred.stlouisfed.org: capital letters, digits or _, up to 25 characters. Examples: DFF, CPIAUCSL. One series per source.
scopeHint.owm_latitude: Decimal degrees from -90 to 90, with a dot as the decimal separator. Example: 21.0285.
scopeHint.owm_longitude: Decimal degrees from -180 to 180, with a dot as the decimal separator. Example: 105.8542.
scopeHint.weather_latitude: Decimal degrees from -90 to 90, with a dot as the decimal separator. Example: 10.8231.
scopeHint.weather_longitude: Decimal degrees from -180 to 180, with a dot as the decimal separator. Example: 106.6297.
scopeHint.weather_timezone: IANA timezone as Region/City used for the hourly times, or UTC. Example: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
scopeHint.weather_metrics: Up to 4 unique values separated by commas or spaces, chosen from: temperature_2m, relative_humidity_2m, precipitation, wind_speed_10m.
scopeHint.openaq_location_id: One numeric station ID from explore.openaq.org. Example: 8118. One station per source.
scopeHint.firms_country: 3-letter ISO country code in capitals. Examples: VNM, THA, USA. One country per source.
scopeHint.youtube_channel_id: The channel ID, not the @handle: 24 characters starting with UC. On the channel page open About, then Share channel, then Copy channel ID. One channel per source.
scopeHint.arxiv_category: One category code, for example cs.AI, math.PR or q-fin.ST (full list at arxiv.org/category_taxonomy). No commas or +; one category per source.
scopeHint.huggingface_author: One user or organization name as in huggingface.co/<name>. Letters, digits, - and _. Examples: google, meta-llama.
scopeHint.bluesky_actor: One handle without @ (for example bsky.app or name.bsky.social) or a DID such as did:plc:….
scopeHint.reddit_subreddit: One subreddit name without r/: 2–21 letters, digits or _. Example: worldnews.
scopeHint.mastodon_instance_url: Server address only: https:// with no path, query or port. Example: https://mastodon.social.
scopeHint.mastodon_account: One account as user or user@server; the leading @ is optional. Leave empty when using a hashtag.
scopeHint.mastodon_hashtag: One hashtag of letters, digits or _; the leading # is optional. Example: news. Leave empty when using an account.
scopeHint.x_account: One username without @: up to 15 letters, digits or _. Leave empty when using a query.
scopeHint.x_query: X recent-search syntax, up to 512 characters: spaces = all words, OR = any word, "quotes" = exact phrase, -word excludes, plus from:user and #tag. Leave empty when using an account.
scopeHint.github_owner: The user or organization in github.com/<owner>/<repository>. Example: vercel.
scopeHint.github_repository: The repository name only, without the owner, a path or .git. Example: next.js.
scopeHint.github_history_days: Whole number of days from 1 to 365 to backfill on the first collection.
scopeHint.market_symbols: Up to 5 unique ticker symbols in capitals, separated by commas or spaces, in the provider format. Examples: IBM, MSFT, TSCO.LON.
scopeHint.market_currency: 3-letter ISO currency code in capitals. Examples: USD, VND. Set together with the exchange timezone.
scopeHint.market_exchange_timezone: IANA timezone of the exchange as Region/City. Example: America/New_York. Set together with the currency.
scopeHint.feed_url: Full http(s) address of one RSS or Atom feed. Example: https://vnexpress.net/rss/tin-moi-nhat.rss.
scopeHint.url: Full http(s) address. A web page is crawled at most 2 links deep and 10 pages; a REST API must return JSON on the default port.
scopeHint.items_path: Dot path to the array of records in the JSON response, for example data.items; use a number for a list position (results.0.items). Required for REST.
scopeHint.id_field: Dot path inside each record to a unique ID, for example id or meta.uuid. Records without it are skipped.
scopeHint.title_field: Optional dot path inside each record to its title, for example title or attributes.name.
scopeHint.content_field: Optional dot path inside each record to its main text. The title is used when it is empty.
scopeHint.updated_field: Optional dot path to a date such as 2026-01-31T08:00:00Z. Records older than the last collection are skipped.
scopeHint.fhir_patient_id: One patient resource ID: letters, digits, . and -, up to 128 characters, no slashes.
scopeHint.timezone: IANA timezone as Region/City used to schedule collection. Example: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
guideSteps.title: How to set this up
impact.gadgets: Used by {gadgets} gadgets on {placements} dashboard placements
guide.title: Setup guide
guide.referenceDate: Each value carries the provider reference date, which can be earlier than the collection time.
guide.annualPeriod: Annual data: each value shows the year it covers, not the collection date.
guide.keyRequired: Required. Provide your own free key; it is saved encrypted and masked afterwards.
guide.verifiedNo: Not yet verified against the live endpoint; use Validate draft to test the connection.
guide.recoveryBody: On failure the last good data stays visible. Fix the cause, then run a manual collection or wait for the next scheduled run.
stale: Stale: no successful collection for over two polling intervals.
scholarly.help: OpenAlex works search (open CC0 data, no key needed). The request URL is built for you; you cannot enter one. Each item shows the title, abstract, authors, source and DOI.
news.help: Unofficial Google News RSS search feed with no official API contract. The feed URL is built for you; you cannot enter one. Each item shows its publisher and links to the original article.
sec.help: SEC EDGAR requires a declared contact. The email is sent only as the request User-Agent; recent filings for this company are collected.
fixedScope: This provider uses a fixed catalog endpoint. There is no scope to configure; choose the schedule below.
guide.exampleNote: Example only: static illustration, not live data.
guide.testNote: Checks the saved draft configuration only. It does not call the provider.
guide.testNeedsSource: Create the source first to test it.
guide.testPassed: Configuration check passed (no provider call was made).
terms.title: Provider terms
terms.required: Terms acknowledgement is required before this source can be activated.
terms.acknowledge: I have read the provider terms for this version and declare the use above.
terms.eligibleYes: Terms accepted. The source can be activated.
terms.notAcknowledged: Terms have not been acknowledged yet.
terms.useIncompatible: The declared use is not allowed by these terms.
terms.operatorReview: An operator must review these terms before activation.
terms.activationBlocked: Activation is blocked until the terms are accepted.
google.mailLabelsHelp: Choose up to 10 labels. The first import covers 30 days; attachments are not downloaded.
google.calendarIdsHelp: Choose up to 25 calendars. Initial coverage is 30 days back and 90 days ahead.
google.driveIdsHelp: Choose up to 100 supported files or folders. Folder contents are expanded recursively within provider and collection limits.
google.readOnlyConsent: Connect a separate read-only Google grant for this source. The app will not request write access.
google.grantNeedsAttention: Google authorization needs attention. Reconnect this source.
google.disconnectFailed: Could not confirm Google token revocation.
google.connectBeforeDiscovery: Connect this source with read-only access before loading its labels, calendars, or Drive files.
google.discoveryFailed: Could not load resources. Check the Google grant and try again.
google.resourcesTruncated: Showing the first 500 matching resources. Narrow the list by browsing into a folder.
google.selectionLimit: Selection limit reached for this provider.
google.reconnectForScope: Google access is source-revision bound. You will authorize once to browse, then authorize again after saving your selections before collection can start.
x.scopeHelp: Choose exactly one of an account or a search query. Only public posts are read.
reddit.readOnlyHelp: Reads public posts only. No votes, comments, or private communities are collected.
reddit.readOnlyConsent: Connect a separate Reddit grant with the read scope. The app does not request write access.
reddit.grantNeedsAttention: Reddit authorization needs attention. Reconnect this source.
reddit.disconnectFailed: Could not confirm Reddit token revocation.
title: Data sources
description: Configure supported sources and collection schedules inside Umwelt-OS.
shape.filterNone: No compatible datasource can be added
shape.filterNoBuiltin: No built-in datasource fits this gadget. Connect a source to add one.
add.builtinAllAdded: Every built-in source is already added.
builtin.resumeTitle: Added built-in sources that are switched off
builtin.resumeFailed: Could not resume this built-in source. Try again.
builtin.useToggle: Built-in sources are switched on with Resume in the list above the sources table.
builtin.alreadyAdded: This built-in source is already added. Resume it from the sources table instead.
builtin.pickHint: Pick the built-in source to add. Sources already added are disabled; resume them from the table.
verify.title: Save and test fetch
verify.intro: Saving enables the source and runs one real collection to prove data can be fetched.
verify.waitingActivation: Waiting for the source to become active…
verify.succeeded: Test fetch succeeded. Data was collected.
verify.noChanges: Test fetch succeeded. The source is reachable and returned no new items.
verify.failed: Test fetch failed: {code}. Go back to fix the settings, then try again.
verify.localOnly: Test fetch failed: this source is local-only. Its data stays on this device, so it cannot be activated for collection.
discard.newSourceBody: This source was created but its data fetch has not been verified. Closing removes it (it is archived, nothing was collected).
builtin.termsHint: Confirm the provider terms and declare how you use the data. A test fetch runs next.
menu.builtinHint: Curated feeds that need no setup
menu.connectorHint: News, crypto, weather, keyed APIs, social and MCP
empty: No sources yet. Connect an RSS feed, web page or REST API, or create a manual source.
retry.label: Retry
mastodon.help: Choose exactly one of an account or a hashtag. Only public posts are read.
notion.pageIdsHelp: Enter 1–100 page IDs (the 32-character code at the end of the page URL) separated by commas or spaces. Share each page with the integration first. Only page text is collected; files and databases are excluded.
slack.channelIdsHelp: Enter 1–100 channel IDs starting with C or G (for example C0123ABCD; in Slack open the channel details to copy it), separated by commas or spaces. The bot must be a channel member. Only top-level messages from the last 30 days are collected; direct messages and replies are excluded.
local.endpointHelp: Only the configured origin and port are contacted. Use a private or loopback address for internal services.
homeAssistant.entityIdsHelp: Enter up to 500 unique entity IDs as domain.object_id in lowercase (for example sensor.living_room_temperature), separated by commas. Only these current states are read; history is not backfilled.
huggingface.author: Hugging Face author
github.cursorInvalid: Saved polling progress needs an explicit reset.
github.evidenceUnverified: {count} GitHub items have uncertain current visibility. Retained owner history remains available for review.
github.sourcePaused: This source is paused, so its current evidence is not available to search.
github.reconcileExhausted: {count} resource reconciliations reached the 100-page limit. Coverage is incomplete.
github.deletionUnsupported: Provider deletions cannot be confirmed automatically. Missing targets stay unverified; delete retained data explicitly when appropriate.
github.peerReview: This revokes the GitHub App grant for {count} connected sources. All listed sources will be paused. Continue?
github.inventoryFailed: Could not load a complete GitHub source inventory.
github.reconciliation: A GitHub authorization, refresh, or revoke operation has an unresolved provider outcome. Owner action is required; reconnect explicitly acknowledges uncertain authorization or refresh cleanup.
github.recoveryDisclosure: Operation {operationId} ({kind}) began for source {sourceId} at generation {generation}, configuration revision {revision}. Acknowledge this exact unresolved operation to fence matching old local authority, then start a fresh GitHub consent flow for the currently selected source.
github.recoveryWait: The GitHub operation is still in its recovery grace period. Wait before resolving it.
github.appHistory: Collects only the selected repository resources. Access uses an installed GitHub App; collection remains bounded and the owner must reconnect after an uncertain token refresh.
github.revokeUnknown: Local sources are paused, but GitHub did not confirm whether the app grant was revoked. Review every affected source and explicitly retry or contact the owner.
telegram.channelHelp: Enter 1–100 signed numeric channel IDs separated by commas or spaces. The bot must be an administrator in every channel.
credential.savedWriteOnly: A key is saved encrypted and is never shown again. Enter a replacement to rotate it.
issuesTitle: Fix these fields, then try again:
issue.format: wrong format; follow the rule under the field
location.denied: Location access was denied. Enter the coordinates manually.
location.unavailable: Location is unavailable. Enter the coordinates manually.
openMeteoTerms: The free API is for non-commercial use and requires attribution. Commercial use requires an appropriate subscription; verify deployment eligibility before activation.
pendingUpdatesOnly: Pending updates received by the bot
youtube.history: Current entries returned by one channel feed request; this is not a transcript or complete channel archive.
arxiv.history: Metadata entries returned by one category feed request; results beyond the bounded page are truncated.
huggingface.history: Up to 100 public model metadata records from one author snapshot; model files and weights are not collected.
github.releasesHistory: Up to five pages of public releases; older release edits may not be detected and private repositories are unsupported.
telegram.history: Pending channel updates still available to this bot; earlier updates, media bytes, and unreceived edits are not reconstructed.
ragIndexHelp: Uses the embedding model so chat and search can answer from this source.

schedule.label: Collection schedule
mcp.collectionHelp: Choose collection grants already reviewed for this source, then provide fixed JSON arguments for each call.
mcp.noConnection: Enable an MCP connection first in MCP settings.
mcp.noGrants: No active collection grants are reviewed for this source.
mcp.argumentsInvalid: Each call argument must be valid JSON.
mcp.collectionSaveFailed: Could not save or activate MCP collection. Reload the source settings and review its grants.
mcp.collectionStaleConflict: These settings changed elsewhere. Your draft is still stale and cannot be saved over the newer settings.
reload.discardConfirmation: Discard this local draft and replace it with the latest saved source settings?
reload.failed: Could not fetch current source settings. Your draft is still here; retry the reload.
activation.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the connector state.
history.label: Available history
header.name: Header name
secretHelp: Leave blank to keep the saved credential. Replacement is held in memory until activation.
validation.passed: Draft configuration and provider checks passed at {time}.
savedInactive: Configuration saved; collection is not active.
collectError.providerRateLimited: The provider is limiting requests. Wait a while, or choose a longer collection interval.
collectError.providerCollectionFailed: The provider could not return data. Try collecting again later.
collectError.retryExhausted: Collection kept failing and was stopped. Check the source settings, then collect again.
collectError.transientFailure: A temporary problem interrupted collection. Collect again in a few minutes.
collectError.collectionUnsupported: This source cannot be collected automatically. Check its collection engine in the settings.
collectError.admissionExpired: The collection request waited too long and expired. Collect again.
collectError.executorError: Collection hit an internal error. Try again, and check the source settings if it repeats.
collectError.invalidNormalizationRecord: The provider returned an item that could not be read. Check the field paths in the source settings.
collectError.recordExceedsNormalizationL: An item from the provider was too large to store. Narrow the source scope.
collectError.cancelled: Collection was cancelled. Collect again when ready.
collectError.sourceGenerationChanged: The source was edited during collection. Collect again.
collectError.requiredCredentialBindingUn: The source needs a saved credential. Add or reconnect it in the source settings.
collectError.providerRevoked: Access to the provider was revoked. Reconnect the source.
rest.headerAuth: Preview is not available with header authentication yet.
rest.truncated: Sample truncated: only the first part of the response is shown.
rest.hint: Click a key to copy its path into the selected field.
restError.restSampleAuthUnsupported: Preview does not support this authentication method.
restError.restSampleUrlRefused: This URL is not allowed (private or unsafe address).
restError.restSampleTooLarge: The response is too large to preview.
restError.restSampleNotJson: The endpoint did not return JSON.
restError.restSampleRateLimited: Too many previews. Wait a moment and try again.
